The '''132nd Forward Division''' was a military unit in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], which fought in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] to overthrow the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and restore the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Serving at some point following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Division/Legends|division]] was stationed in the<ref name="SWTS" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]'<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]]. Among its [[Officer/Legends|officers]] was [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Belyssa Romey]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]].<ref name="SWTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 132nd Forward Division was mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]].<ref name="SWTS" />
